title: Detection Is Not Early Warning: Evaluating Token-Level Alarms on Language Model Failures
abstract: arXiv:2611.16803v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Many failures of language models begin at a specific token, the onset. A monitor that reads the model during generation can classify the finished response, detect the failure once it is under way, or warn before it begins, and only a warning leaves time to stop or steer the generation. Monitors are usually evaluated with response-level metrics such as AUROC, which ignore when the monitor fires. We introduce PREWARN, an evaluation protocol for any failure with an annotated onset. It calibrates each monitor's threshold on validation data to an error rate chosen for the application, runs the monitor, and scores its alarms relative to the onset on all three tasks. As a case study we apply it to repetitive degeneration in three open language models, with early warning as the main task, using linear probes on activations and six untrained baselines. translated_title: 检测并非预警：评估针对语言模型失效的Token级警报
translated_abstract: 许多语言模型的失效始于某个特定的token，即“起点”。一个在生成过程中读取模型的监控器可以对已完成的响应进行分类、在失效进行中检测到它，或者在它开始之前发出预警——只有预警才能留出时间来停止或引导生成过程。监控器通常使用响应级指标（如AUROC）进行评估，这些指标忽略了监控器何时触发。我们提出了PREWARN，这是一个适用于任何具有标注起点的失效的评估协议。它根据验证数据将每个监控器的阈值校准到应用所需的错误率，运行监控器，并就三项任务相对于起点对其警报进行评分。作为案例研究，我们将其应用于三个开源语言模型的重复性退化问题，以早期预警为主要任务，使用基于激活的线性探针和六个未训练的基线。响应级指标在这种失效上已经饱和，而一个仅读取响应……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了PREWARN评估协议，将监控器的评估从单纯检测失效转向在失效token起点之前发出预警，从而为停止或干预生成过程争取时间。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PREWARN, an evaluation protocol that shifts monitoring from merely detecting model failures to issuing token-level early warnings before the failure's onset, leaving time to stop or steer generation.
